question: An engineer must configure a VXLAN routing on a Cisco Nexus 9000 Series switch. The engineer requires a solution where all the leaf switches have the same gateway MAC and IP addresses. Which configuration set accomplishes this task?
options: NX9K(config)# fabric forwarding anycast-gateway-mac AA:BB:AA:BB:AA:BB NX9K(config)# interface VLAN-interface-name NX9K(config-if)# vrf member vrf-name NX9K(config-if)# fabric forwarding mode anycast-gateway

NX9K(config)# install feature-set fabric NX9K(config)# feature-set fabric NX9K(config)# fabric forwarding anycast-gateway-mac AA:BB:AA:BB:AA:BB NX9K(config)# interface VLAN-interface-name NX9K(config-if)# fabric forwarding mode anycast-gateway

NX9K(config)# install feature-set fabric NX9K(config)# feature-set fabric NX9K(config)# interface VLAN-interface-name NX9K(config-if)# fabric forwarding anycast-gateway-mac AA:BB:AA:BB:AA:BB NX9K(config-if)# fabric forwarding mode anycast-gateway
NX9K(config)# fabric forwarding anycast-gateway-mac AA:BB:AA:BB:AA:BB NX9K(config)# interface VLAN-interface-name NX9K(config-if)# fabric forwarding mode anycast-gateway
theory: VXLAN's distributed anycast gateway lets every leaf switch present the exact same gateway IP and MAC address for a given subnet, so a host's default gateway is always answered locally by whichever leaf it's attached to, with no need to route traffic to a specific gateway leaf. Configuring a common "fabric forwarding anycast-gateway-mac" globally and then enabling "fabric forwarding mode anycast-gateway" under each SVI/VRF member interface is what makes every leaf share that identical gateway MAC and IP for the VNI. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 3 — VXLAN Distributed Anycast Gateway)
